prompts.Fire:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single standalone trading-card background plate, portrait 63:88 ratio, high resolution.
Use the supplied card image strictly as a STYLE and composition reference. Create the FIRE element background ONLY. Remove ALL character art, fists, emblems, number tabs, postal label, names, rules, symbols, UI, words and lettering. We need an empty printed background ready for existing character artwork and real UI to be composited later.
Keep the reference's sharp anime cel-shaded fighting-game comic aesthetic, black brush ink, rough screenprint halftone and torn angular paper edges. No photo, no glossy plastic, no scene/location, no rounded rectangle chips.
Composition: full portrait printed paper plate. Center upper 68% is a broad subdued warm charcoal space with restrained black ink movement, mostly quiet to receive a character. Surround the perimeter with jagged vermilion, ember orange, restrained hot yellow and small bone-white paper cuts. Directional fire tongues along perimeter point upward/right; keep center free. Bottom 25% is one broad nearly-black rough ink/paint field, horizontal and quiet, subtly torn slanted edge, integrated with outer art, EMPTY without text; texture must be subtle enough for future readable white paragraphs. No internal boxed panels; no deliberate empty number rectangles.
The image should feel designed and detailed like reference yet keep color energy mainly in narrow perimeter, not a dense explosion covering the whole center. Matte baseline only; no rainbow foil, gold rarity, stickers, crowns, logos or watermarks. Outside edge may bleed to image boundaries.
prompts.Emblems:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE consistent concept sheet of TEN freestanding elemental fist emblems on a genuinely transparent alpha background, arranged 5 columns by 2 rows with ample empty gutters. No text or labels anywhere. Use attached card only for rough anime fighting-game screenprint style and the lower-right RED/BLACK FIST mark as the fist-shape reference. NOT the rectangular postal label. Each emblem must consist only of an identical bold front-facing clenched fist, wrist end short, thick irregular black ink outline, hard cel shading. Fist occupies left 55–60% of each emblem. Element silhouette grows from behind its RIGHT knuckles toward upper right and right edge; no element on the left. Open asymmetric silhouettes, no background tile, no rectangular/plaque/hexagonal border, no rounded chips, no metallic card frame, no surrounding enclosure, no crowns.
Order left to right top row: NORMAL warm bone/black fist with a simple ivory impact burst extending right (NOT rainbow/disco); FIRE vermilion/black fist with ember-orange flame extending right; WATER cobalt/black fist with cyan crest of liquid water extending right; PLANT jade/black fist with pointed leaf and vine extending right; AIR bone/black fist with silver-blue wind feathers/swooshes extending right.
Bottom row left to right: ELECTRIC ochre-gold/black fist with lightning bolts extending right; POISON plum/black fist with magenta venom drops and ink wisps extending right; LIGHT bone/black fist with pale gold halo arc and rays extending right; DARK deep indigo/black fist with violet shadow blade and crescent extending right; EARTH terracotta/black fist with ochre fractured stone slabs extending right, visibly different from Plant.
Match fist geometry across all ten. Keep recognizable knuckles, thumb and curled fingers. Match reference's hand-inked anime/comic marks, restrained halftone, rough white highlights, strong flat shapes readable small. Color mainly in element tail and fist face. Each emblem has near 1.5:1 aspect, no clipping, no shared connecting decoration. No people, no letters, no stars unrelated to element, no 3D plastic or glittery square backing.
prompts.Backgrounds:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE art-direction sheet of TEN background-only trading-card plates, five columns and two rows, each separate portrait 63:88 silhouette with consistent dimensions and equal gutters, on a flat dark-neutral canvas. No titles or labels anywhere; no text. Reference image is style reference ONLY.
Every plate uses rough black comic ink, anime cel shading, dry brush cuts, worn screenprint halftone, narrow angular torn-paper perimeter; a broad QUIET charcoal center for a future character; bottom quarter a broad nearly-black EMPTY brush-ink rules area integrated into the plate. NO UI or framed number slots, NO stats, NO names, NO postal labels, NO characters, NO fists or other emblems. No city scenes, no modern metallic 3D panels, no checkerboards. Baseline matte printed ink, no rarity foil yet.
Ten different elemental designs; order matters:
Top row left to right 1 NORMAL: warm ivory newsprint/charcoal abstract impact strokes, no rainbow. 2 FIRE: vermilion/orange tongues licking upward with restrained gold sparks. 3 WATER: cobalt/cyan wave crests and liquid brush ribbons, not ice. 4 PLANT: forest/jade leaves and angular vines, not rocks. 5 AIR: cool bone/slate blue feathered wind cuts and airy negative gaps.
Bottom row left to right 6 ELECTRIC: ochre/acid-yellow zigzag current with a little cold white lightning. 7 POISON: plum/magenta viscous drips and black fumes. 8 LIGHT: ivory/pale gold radial shafts and fine halo arcs with warm gray center. 9 DARK: ink-indigo/deep violet shadow blades and dark crescent folds. 10 EARTH: terracotta/sandstone broken strata and sharp ochre stone splinters.
Keep all 10 centers charcoal and subdued, at least 60% quiet dark space, color concentrated around perimeter. Bottom rule zones have consistent geometry and matte black value so future white text will be readable. Similar visual detail budget across all plates, differentiate by motif as well as palette. Match reference's illustrated screenprinted torn-paper aesthetic. No lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, crowns, packaged cards, or perspective view. Flat front-on 2D designs.
prompts.FireAlpha: Edit target: the supplied Fire background plate. Preserve its existing black/red/orange screenprint illustration and its empty composition. Remove the gray-and-white checkerboard that is visibly baked around its outer silhouette. Replace ONLY that exterior with a genuine transparent alpha background; do not draw a checkerboard or black canvas there. Keep opaque charcoal paper inside the plate. Keep center empty, bottom quiet black paint area empty, no characters, no text, no number slots, no emblems. Also simplify the two little sharp inner separators above the bottom black region so it reads as brush-painted paper rather than a separate rectangular UI box. Deliver a single portrait 63:88 background plate with actual transparency around irregular torn edges. No added glows outside edges.
prompts.Rules: Use case: background-extraction. Reference is the provided illustrated trading card. Extract and reimagine ONLY the broad bottom black ink-painted paper area as a standalone reusable graphic, without any text or characters. Horizontal aspect 3.4:1. Solid nearly-black brushed paper center (low-contrast charcoal fibers) occupying 85% of graphic, subtle bone-white torn paper at some outer corners, raw jagged black ink silhouette, very slight skewed top edge. Flat 2D anime comic screenprint texture matching the reference, sophisticated restrained distress. No red/yellow elemental decorations, no frame, no regular border, no shadow/glow, no label, no lettering, no rules, no words, no UI, no fist, no crown. Genuine transparent alpha outside the rough edges; NEVER a printed checkerboard. This is the universal blank rules-paper layer and must provide an uninterrupted low-noise black interior for readable white paragraphs to be overlaid later.
prompts.GoldFists:
Use case: precise-object-edit / element-emblem system redesign.
Input 1 is the supplied gold-fist elemental badge sheet. PRESERVE THE EXACT GOLD FIST DESIGN from this input: four chunky curled finger columns, thumb sweeping beneath to right, golden yellow face with orange cel-shaded lower edges, thick black ink contour. Reuse the SAME fist shape, orientation, gold color and size for every emblem.
Remove ALL rectangular plates, chip shapes, outlines around plates, glass frames, backing shapes, left-side decorations and square enclosures. Each output is ONLY the freestanding gold fist with its elemental form emerging from BEHIND ITS RIGHT EDGE and extending right / upper-right. There must be transparent empty space immediately to the left of every fist; no surrounding shape there. Flat anime/comic cel shading with crisp bold ink, tasteful textured detailing, no soft bloom or atmospheric glow outside the drawn silhouette.
Deliver ONE high-resolution sheet with TEN individual emblems, five columns and two rows, generous even gaps, fully inside canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background, NO black background, NO gray background, NO checkerboard, NO shadows, NO color halos. No text, numbers, captions, UI, crowns or watermarks.
Row 1 left to right: Normal (small ivory impact swoosh/burst to right; no disco sphere), Fire (red orange flame to right), Water (cobalt/cyan wave crest to right), Plant (jade pointed leaves and vine to right), Air (pearl blue winglike wind sweep to right).
Row 2 left to right: Electric (yellow/white lightning to right), Poison (magenta/plum venom droplet with wisp to right), Light (pale ivory/gold halo arc and short rays to right), Dark (deep violet shadow crescent/blades to right), Earth (terracotta fractured stone slabs to right).
Element takes about 40% of each 1.5:1 silhouette's width, fist about60%. Gold fist remains the same neutral brand anchor across all elements. NO element reshaping or recoloring the fist. An open silhouette, not a badge card.
